acceptanceRecords.observableRequirement: Phase 0 package and verifier setup exist, validate, remain scoped to governance surfaces, and preserve production NO-GO boundaries.
acceptanceRecords.protectionMechanism: Tracked Node verifier plus strict governance plan validation.
preconditions: lock.json files have been generated for setup and main plan packages
requiredAssertions: main package contains PHASE-0 through PHASE-6
every in-scope requirement has plan, scope, and acceptance coverage
Phase 0 scope excludes product runtime, migrations, dependencies, workflows, and external systems
acceptanceRecords.expectedTestCountOrInventory: single verifier command checks setup and main package integrity
acceptanceRecords.artifactType: command output and ignored runtime run-record
acceptanceRecords.artifactRetentionPolicy: runtime artifacts remain ignored and uncommitted; evidence summary is tracked
acceptanceRecords.artifactPrivacyPolicy: No secrets, PHI, raw prompts, raw health data, or real user data.
acceptanceRecords.independentVerifier: NOT_REQUESTED unless user explicitly requests review
acceptanceRecords.passRule: PASS only when the verifier exits 0 and governance validation exits 0.
acceptanceRecords.failRule: FAIL when the verifier exits non-zero, validation fails, or Phase 0 touches protected product and external-system surfaces.
acceptanceRecords.blockedRule: BLOCKED when Node or Git is unavailable.
forbiddenEquivalences: File existence without lock hash integrity is not PASS
Skipped or stale verification is not PASS
